greeting.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
text: You've got the good boots. That means you walked here on purpose.
Nobody comes to this end of the village unless they're lost or looking. Which?
I've been counting the crows on the well rope. You've made me lose the number.

again.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
text: I told them you'd come back and they said I made you up. Stand still a moment so they can see.
Still the good boots. Muddier, though. Where've they been?
You're the second thing this week that came back when it wasn't supposed to. The other was a gull.

options.text: What have you heard about us?
Stay out of the reeds, Pell.

the_pond.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
the_pond.text: Something that was a horse. Nobody will fish it out, so nobody drinks from that end any more.

safer.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
safer.text: This is the safer place. That's the whole joke. I was crew until the crew stopped coming back, and all the sea left me was the scabbard.

coin.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
coin.text: I'll tell them a knight gave it me. They won't believe the knight part.

the_crew.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
the_crew.text: They went out on a good tide and came back as wood. I keep the scabbard because it's the only bit that came back whole.

the_story.speaker: Pell the Cabin Hand
text: That you don't sleep. I said that was daft. Do you sleep?
The smith says you'll come to nothing. The smith says that about the weather too.
They've started using your name to make us come in at dark. It works.
